title: Old swords
description: you can have 1.8 swords in newest versions!
body:
⚔️ 1.8 Swords — The return of classic swords!

This mod adds old animations and the appearance of swords from Minecraft 1.8 to older versions of the game. Thanks to it, you can feel the classic PvP atmosphere and return to the old days of combat!

✨ Fashion features:

• Classic swords from version 1.8

• Old holding and hitting animations

• Better PvP climate

• Lightweight and easy to use

• Perfect for old-school Minecraft fans

If you miss the old fighting style, this mod is just for you!
